title: Colour test sheet: warm and cool in illusions
subject: Art & Design
source: Written for art/y9 lesson 6 (Colour test sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6. Test which colours make the illusion strongest.

blocks.h: Two tests of your warped grid

questions.q: Which square seems nearer, and why?
questions.a: The red one: warm colours advance and cool colours recede.

questions.q: Which test made the stronger illusion? Write your colour plan. Start: 'I will use... because...'
questions.a: For example: warm bulge on a cool background, with complementary edges to make them flicker.
